title: fix(spec)!: spell the seven multi-word taxonomy values as identifiers so a select can carry them
body:
Fixes #31066

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — seven accepted facet values change spelling, inside the marketplace-taxonomy narrowing of the same release; no published version carried the hyphenated spelling
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no `skills/**` file names a facet value; the hand-written handbook example and the generated reference pages carry the identifier spellings in this diff

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：市场分类里 7 个带连字符的值改成下划线写法（customer-service → customer_service、supply-chain → supply_chain，行业 5 个同理），顺序和数量上限不变；另加一条守卫测试：分类里任何值都必须能当下拉选项的值。
- **为什么改**：按你的裁决「spec 改成下划线（推荐）」。下拉选项的值只允许小写字母、数字、下划线和点，带连字符的值进不了 select，cloud#3661 就没法把「职能」「行业」做成带选项的下拉，控制台 #31011 也按选项取标签。**下一版 CLI 发版要等这张卡和 objectstack-ai/cloud#3661 都完成。**
- **风险与回滚**：低。这 7 个值是 #30980 引入的，还没有任何版本发布过（spec 18.3.0 在它合并前就已发布），所以没有已发布的数据或包会用到旧写法；回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：① `packages/spec/src/marketplace/taxonomy.zod.ts`（两个枚举里的 7 个值和 `LEGACY_CATEGORY_MAPPING` 的 erp 一行）；② `packages/spec/src/marketplace/taxonomy.test.ts` 末尾新增的守卫测试；③ `.changeset/30904-marketplace-taxonomy.md` 里被改正的一句（未发布的发布说明，下面 Acceptance notes 有说明）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/marketplace/taxonomy.test.ts`，预期 41 个测试全绿；把任一值改回连字符再跑，守卫测试变红。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/marketplace/taxonomy.zod.ts`: `MarketplaceBusinessFunctionSchema` respells `customer-service` → `customer_service` and `supply-chain` → `supply_chain`; `MarketplaceIndustrySchema` respells `trade-distribution`, `professional-services`, `financial-services`, `public-sector` and `real-estate-construction` with underscores. Order and arity (1-3 / 0-3) unchanged. `LEGACY_CATEGORY_MAPPING.erp` now maps to `['finance', 'supply_chain']`; the legacy category KEYS (`developer-tools`, `ui-theme`) are old values written in the wild and stay as they are. The module doc now states that every value is a `SystemIdentifierSchema` identifier.
- Guard test (`taxonomy.test.ts`, block `id`): walks every export of `taxonomy.zod.ts` that has string `options` (so an enum added later is judged without being listed), floors the walk at the four known enums and 26 values, and parses every value as `SystemIdentifierSchema` and as a full `SelectOptionSchema` `{ label, value }`.
- Carriers: `docs/qa/scenarios/service_desk.json` and `requisition_to_receipt.json`; `packages/cli/test/package-publish-taxonomy.test.ts` (the refusal that lists business functions, and the wire-name test); `content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx`; regenerated `content/docs/references/marketplace/*.mdx` (`check:generated --fix`).
- Nothing to change, checked: the three connector manifests carry `collaboration`/`legal`, `it` and `finance`; the liveness rows (`packages/spec/liveness/template_manifest.json`) name no value; the scenario schema and the CLI publish path read the spec enums (`MarketplaceBusinessFunctionSchema.options`), so only their fixtures and tests carried spellings. `git grep` for the seven hyphenated spellings now hits only the new changeset's FROM/TO table, CHANGELOG history and an unrelated `supply-chain` comment in `release.yml`.
- Changesets: new `.changeset/31066-taxonomy-identifiers.md` (`@objectstack/spec: minor`, both declaration lines, FROM/TO table). ADR-0087 disposition: `not-required (already-registered marketplace-category-retired)` — reasoning under Acceptance notes.

<details><summary>Ablation of the guard test</summary>

Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` under the verify lock, on committed head `b56f1fb013`: anchor `'real_estate_construction', //` x1 → x0, replacement `'real-estate-construction', //` x0 → x1, blob `c960cff330ba` → `8b9e00123016`. `vitest run src/marketplace/taxonomy.test.ts`: **1 failed | 40 passed**, the failure exactly the guard (`MarketplaceIndustrySchema: real-estate-construction: expected false to be true`). Restore: blob after restore == HEAD blob `c960cff330ba`, `git diff HEAD` empty. A value no other test names was chosen so only the guard could turn red.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **DELIBERATE CORRECTION of a pending release note.** `.changeset/30904-marketplace-taxonomy.md` (pending, from #30980, unreleased) listed the business functions with the old spelling; this PR made that sentence false, so it is corrected in place rather than restored. Corrected sentence: "`businessFunctions` (1-3 distinct values, the primary one first: `sales`, `marketing`, `customer_service`, `finance`, `hr`, `supply_chain`, `administration`, `project`, `legal`, `it`, `collaboration`)". `check-empty-changeset` stays red on that file by design until the dispatching seat confirms the correction by its own record.
- **ADR-0087: no new ledger entry.** The seven values were introduced by #30980 (merged `468e0c16`, 2026-11-06T18:46Z); `@objectstack/spec@18.3.0`, the latest published version, was published 2026-11-03T15:15Z, before that merge, and #30980's changeset is still pending in `.changeset/`. So no published spec ever accepted the hyphenated spelling, and no stored row or authored source made against a release can hold it. `marketplace-category-retired` (present at the merge base) is the upgrade path from a released spec — `category` to the facets of `taxonomy.zod.ts` and `LEGACY_CATEGORY_MAPPING` — and names no value, so it stays complete. A value-rename entry would project into the upgrade guide a rename no released author can meet (ADR-0087's table calls that false data in the ledger); enum values also have no `retiredKey` surface. Disposition: `not-required (already-registered marketplace-category-retired)`; `check-adr-0087-registration` passes.
- Consumers that follow: objectstack-ai/cloud#3661 (selects with options and translations, after its pin moves past this merge) and #31011 (console labels keyed by `.options`). objectstack-ai/cloud#3689 pins `90523379` and is unaffected until that follow-up.
- Merged `origin/main` (`3f61e4f8fb`) before opening: main had moved `taxonomy.test.ts`, `publish.ts` and the template-manifest reference page; the deferred page was regenerated from the merged tree (`f7a05c8600`), and every reading below was retaken on that head.
